units.source_text: 总之，我是个本想走正直的路，却不慎走偏的蠢货，或者说是个狡猾的男人。

en.t: In short, I was a fool who had meant to walk the path of honesty but had inadvertently strayed from it, or perhaps I was a cunning man.

units.source_text: 而知道这一点的，现在只有老天爷和我的心。

en.t: And at present, the only ones who knew this were Heaven and my own heart.

units.source_text: 但是，倘若我想要修正方向，重新向前迈步的话，便会陷入不得不把走偏的原委告知众人的窘境。

en.t: But if I tried to correct my course and take another step forward, I would find myself in the awkward position of having to tell everyone how I had gone astray.

units.source_text: 我想将此事隐瞒到底，同时又不能不继续往前走，我被困其间，进退不得。

en.t: I wanted to conceal the matter to the end, yet at the same time I had to keep moving forward; trapped between the two, I could neither advance nor retreat.

units.source_text: 过了五六天之后，夫人突然问我，那件事你跟K说了吗？

en.t: Five or six days later, the lady of the house suddenly asked me whether I had told K about that matter.

units.source_text: 我说还没有，夫人便追问我为什么不告诉K。

en.t: I said I had not yet, and she pressed me as to why I had not told K.

units.source_text: 面对夫人的诘问，我无言以对。

en.t: Faced with her reproachful question, I had no answer.

units.source_text: 当时，夫人说了句令我震惊的话，至今我都忘不了。

en.t: At that time, she said something that shocked me, and I still have not forgotten it.

units.source_text: 夫人说：‘怪不得我告诉他的时候，他的脸色很不好呢。

en.t: She said, 'No wonder he looked so upset when I told him.

units.source_text: 你也不应该呀，你们平时那么要好，却不告诉他，若无其事的。’

en.t: It was wrong of you too. You are usually so close to him, yet you kept quiet and acted as if nothing had happened.'

units.source_text: 我问夫人，K当时说了些什么。

en.t: I asked the lady of the house what K had said at the time.
She replied that he had not said anything in particular.

units.source_text: 我自然想知道详细情况，便追问下去。

en.t: Naturally, I wanted to know the details, so I kept asking.

units.source_text: 夫人原本也不必隐瞒什么，便说其实也没说什么，并把K当时的表现一五一十地告诉了我。

en.t: Since she had no reason to hide anything in the first place, she said that there really had not been much, and told me every detail of how K had behaved at the time.
